_how: Add one entry per component you bolt onto S1, then re-run: python simple/calc/s1_select.py. body = pelvis, torso, head, neck_link, shoulder, upper_arm, forearm, wrist, hand, hip_yaw_link, hip_roll_link, thigh, shank, foot; side = l, r or both (limbs only); kg = measured mass; xyz = metres from the joint at the top of that body (x forward, z up); cat = sensor, electronics, structure, hand, harness. Example: {"body": "head", "name": "Livox Mid-360 lidar + bracket", "kg": 0.32, "xyz": [0.02, 0, 0.16], "cat": "sensor"}
